High-performing Full Stack Engineer with 7+ years of experience engineering high-throughput distributed microservices, fault-tolerant cloud infrastructure, and modern responsive front-ends. Reduced p99 API latency across public endpoints from 310ms to 48ms via multi-tiered Redis caching and query indexing.
